completed_items.complex_edit_acceptance: Three branch-like manifest/rename cycles, 16 generated files per batch, alternating incomplete/valid edits in two buffers, cancellation response, dependent diagnostics, moved definitions, quiescence and removed symbol recovery. Existing reload/close/delete/stale diagnostic tests included in full gates. No fresh heap/RSS benchmark claim.
